name: search_product
description: Find products by name, brand or active ingredient (Arabic or English), or by what the customer needs something for.

active_ingredient.description: Only an ingredient the customer wrote or that is on their prescription.

need.description: Only when the customer wants something FOR a symptom or purpose and names no product (e.g. 'دوا للصداع', 'something for a blocked nose'): that need. The system picks the over-the-counter products - never choose a medicine or ingredient yourself.

returns.description: candidates: list of {product_id, name_ar, name_en, brand, scientific_name, price_sar, match, requires_prescription}; alternatives: same active ingredient, other brands; active_ingredient; note (e.g. requested strength not available); hint when nothing matched. Lists may be empty.

errors.when: query, active_ingredient and need all missing or empty
